description: Image Description: The image shows a snowy outdoor scene with two snowmen in a yard. The foreground features a snowman wearing a knitted hat and scarf. The background shows another snowman in the distance. Snow covers the ground, and there are patches of grass visible. A tennis racket is placed upright in the right part of the scene. The sky is partly cloudy with a hint of a sunset, and trees and a fence are visible in the background.
